headline:
خلل يوقف خوادم
لعبتين من DARK SOULS
label: رسمي
note: FromSoftware Player Support (@fromsoftware_sp, 30 Oct 07:01Z, read via X embed 09:20Z): game servers for DARK SOULS II and DARK SOULS III stopped on all platforms after a server bug was found; restoration time to be announced separately. Cause not detailed, offline play not mentioned. Footage: Bandai Namco's DARK SOULS III pre-order trailer (Steam 374320, 1080p), music only (whisper: no speech 26 to 106 s); text cards at 31 to 33, 60 to 62, 68 to 70, 96 to 99 and 105+ avoided; the DS II trailer is 720p at 2.5 Mbps, left out.
